title: Ukukhishwa kwe-Kyber 0.26
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Sikhipha inguqulo yethu 0.26, enezibuyekezo ezintathu ezinkulu: ibhodi lokunamathisela elithuthukisiwe, i-OpenID Connect nokwenziwa ngcono kokucutshungulwa kwemidiya, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuncane okuningi.
html:
I-Kyber 0.26 isifikile!

I-Kyber 0.26 isikhishiwe.

Lokhu kukhishwa kuletha ukusekelwa kokuqinisekisa ngobunikazi nge-OIDC, ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu kokubhalwa kwevidiyo ngamakhodi, ibhodi lokunamathisela elisebenza kangcono kuzo zonke izinkundla, izindlela ezintsha zokuthwebula isikrini ku-Linux, kanye nohlu olude lokulungiswa okuqinisa uzinzo kulo lonke uhlelo lwedeskithophu.

Nakhu okugqame kakhulu.

Ukusekelwa kwe-OIDC

I-Kyber manje isisekela i-OpenID Connect (OIDC) ekuqinisekiseni ubunikazi, futhi itholakala kokubili ku-kycontroller nakuklayenti ledeskithophu. Usungakwazi ukuxhuma i-Kyber nohlelo lwakho olukhona lokuphatha ubunikazi, kungaba yi-Keycloak, i-Auth0, i-Authelia, noma yiluphi olunye uhlelo lwe-SSO oluhambisana namazinga avunyelwene ngawo.

Lesi yisinyathelo esikhulu ezinhlanganweni ezisebenzisa i-Kyber ezindaweni ezinabasebenzisi abaningi noma emabhizinisini amakhulu, lapho ukuphathwa kobunikazi endaweni eyodwa kuyisidingo esingenakugwenywa.

Ibhodi lokunamathisela elithuthukisiwe

Ukuphathwa kwebhodi lokunamathisela kuthatha igxathu elikhulu kulokhu kukhishwa. Imishini esingathekisayo ye-Linux esebenzisa i-X11 manje isikwazi ukwabelana ngebhodi lokunamathisela, kanti i-Windows yengeza ukusekelwa okugcwele kwe-HTML ebhodini lokunamathisela, eceleni kombhalo ongenakufometha owethulwa ngaphambilini. Okuqukethwe okunothile — umbhalo onezitayela, izixhumanisi nemininingwane efomethiwe — manje sekungakopishwa futhi kunamathiselwe phakathi kwemishini ku-Windows ngendlela efanayo naleyo obungakwenza ngayo kumshini owodwa.

Ukuthuthukiswa kokubhalwa kwevidiyo ngamakhodi

I-kymedia ibuyekezelwe ku-FFmpeg 8.1, okuletha intuthuko yakamuva yama-codec, ukulungiswa kwamaphutha nokusebenza okusheshayo okuvela kubathuthukisi bayo abangumthombo.

Izilungiselelo zokubhala ngamakhodi ze-AMF (AMD) ne-VAAPI zithuthukiswe kakhulu, futhi lokho kunomthelela obonakalayo ekubambezelekeni. Abasebenzisi be-AMD ikakhulukazi bazowubona umehluko: ukubambezeleka kokubhala ngamakhodi manje sekusondele kulokho obungakulindela ku-Nvidia.

Ku-Windows, i-kymedia/vlc manje isisebenzisa i-GUID ejwayelekile ye-Microsoft yokuncishiswa kwemininingwane yombala ye-HEVC 4:2:2 ne-4:4:4, esikhundleni saleyo eyayiqondene ne-Intel kuphela. Lokhu kufinyelela uhla olubanzi lwemishini yehadiwe futhi kuthembeke kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwangempela.

Izindlela ezintsha zokuthwebula isikrini ku-Linux

I-kymedia ithola izinketho ezimbili ezintsha ze-grab_backend: i-xcb ne-wlroots. Abasebenzisi be-Linux manje sebenokusekelwa kwemvelo kokuthwebula kokubili ezinhlelweni ze-X11 nezakwa-wlroots (Wayland), okwandisa ukuhambisana nezindawo zedeskithophu ezahlukene.

Isilawuli se-WebSocket manje sisebenzisa i-kycom

I-controller/ws manje isisebenzisa i-kycom ukuxhumana ne-kyavserver kanye ne-kynput, esikhundleni sendlela yangaphambili yokuxhumana ngqo. Lokhu kuyenza ihambisane nalo lonke olunye uhlelo.

Ukulungiswa okuqinisa uzinzo

Ukulungiswa okuningana kubhekana nezimo ezingavamile ebezingadala ukuphahlazeka, ukuqalwa kabusha okungapheli, noma ukwehluleka okudidayo:

kycontroller/win32 : Ukuqaliswa kwesithonjana endaweni yezaziso manje akusabangeli ukuwa kohlelo. I-Kyber iyalulama kahle uma kutholakala umlayezo we-TaskbarCreated, ngakho isebenza ngendlela efanele ngisho noma i-Explorer iqala kabusha noma ibha yemisebenzi iphuza ukuvela.

kyservice/win32 : Isevisi ayisazingeli ngokungapheli uma ihlangabezana nokulungiselelwa okungalungile.

kycontroller : Inani lamaklayenti elikhonjiswa endaweni yezaziso manje seliyabuyekezeka ngendlela efanele uma iseshini iphelelwa yisikhathi.

kycontroller : Isiqaphi sohlelo manje asisona isibopho.

kycontroller : Indlela yokusebenza ye-RTP isilungisiwe. Yayiyeke ukusebenza buthule ngemuva kokwengezwa kokusekelwa kwe-IPv6 ku-0.25.0.

Amathuluzi okuguqula amakhodi okuskena ekhibhodi manje atholakala kuzo zonke izinkundla

I-kynput manje isinikeza amathuluzi okuguqula amakhodi okuskena ekhibhodi kuzo zonke izinkundla. Lokhu kuwusizo kubahlanganisi abadinga ukuphatha lawa makhodi ngendlela efanayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isistimu yokusebenza eqondiwe iyiphi.

I-Web: uphawu olusha nokuhlelwa kabusha kwezidlali zomsindo nevidiyo

Isixhumi esibonakalayo sewebhu manje sesiza nophawu olusha lwe-Kyber. Ngasohlangothini lwe-kyctl, izidlali zomsindo nevidiyo zihlukaniselwe kumaphakheji ahlukene e-Rust, okwenza kube lula ukunakekela nokwandisa ikhodi phambili.

Ukubuyekeza

I-Kyber 0.26 isiyatholakala manje. Vakashela ikhasi lokulanda ukuze uthole inguqulo yakamuva, noma udonse amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngendlela yakho ejwayelekile.

Imibono yenu nemibiko yamaphutha yamukelekile kakhulu.
